data.body: Plan-review returned BLOCK: E4/G1G2 flagged that the plan misattributed the new llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir key to core src/rebar/config.py, but llm.* is a RESERVED section resolved on LLMConfig in src/rebar/llm/config.py (via _read_llm_file_table/read_reserved_section + _llm_str). Revised Approach/Scope to: add the field to LLMConfig + resolve in from_env via _llm_str/REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR; name the exact write seam (_pai_structured prompted branch before 'raise last', dir read via resolve_gate_config); and added G6 positive rationale + edge/failure handling (best-effort write never masks the original error, mkdir, mtime rotation). Re-reviewing.
